title: Continuity on N of the tangential Jacobian J(x) = √det(⟨DΦ(x)τ_i, DΦ(x)τ_j⟩) (Simon Ch. 2, 4.2 and 4.11–4.12; parent steps 3–4)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let N ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded m-dimensional C¹ submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m N). That is, every y ∈ N lies in an open W ⊆ ℝ^P carrying a local representation ψ : ℝ^m → ℝ^P as in Simon (4.1): V ⊆ ℝ^m is open, ψ is C¹ on V and injective on V, ψ(V) = W ∩ N, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ is injective on V. Let Q : ℝ^P → {linear subspaces of ℝ^P} satisfy Q(x) = T_xN as sets for every x ∈ N, and let Φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be C¹. Let J(x) := (det(⟨DΦ(x)τ_i(x), DΦ(x)τ_j(x)⟩)_{i,j<dim Q(x)})^{1/2}, where τ(x) = stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q x). Then J is continuous on N, relative to N.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m N → (∀ x ∈ N, (Q x : Set (Euclid P)) = tangentSpace N x) → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (Q x)) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q x) i)) (fderiv ℝ Φ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q x) j))))) N
